node.statement: Let delta<=1/2 and let w:C^m->A be an extended delta-inclusion. By def-extended-delta-inclusion, its n=1 amplification is a delta-inclusion and obeys the lower norm bound ||w(x)|| >= (1-delta)||x||. Hence ||w(x)|| >= (1/2)||x|| for every x, so w(x)=0 forces x=0 and w is injective.
